# energy.energy_consumption

<!-- Generated by dctl from the contract. Do not edit by hand. -->

Hourly energy consumption per meter and energy carrier, with the associated greenhouse gas emissions in kilograms of CO2 equivalent. Feeds energy cost and decarbonisation reporting.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Required | Classification | Checks | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `meter_id` (key) | `STRING` | yes | internal | pattern `^MTR-[0-9]{5}$` | Business key of the energy meter. |
| `reading_hour` (key) | `TIMESTAMP` | yes | internal |  | Start of the hour the reading covers, in UTC. |
| `site_code` | `STRING` | yes | internal | pattern `^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{2}$` | Code of the site where the meter is installed. |
| `asset_id` | `STRING` | no | internal | pattern `^AST-[0-9]{6}$` | Asset the meter is attached to. Empty for site level meters. |
| `energy_carrier` (key) | `STRING` | yes | internal | one of `electricity`, `natural_gas`, `steam`, `compressed_air` | Form of energy measured by the meter. |
| `consumption_kwh` | `DECIMAL(18,3)` | yes | internal | min 0 | Energy consumed during the hour, converted to kilowatt hours. |
| `co2e_kg` | `DECIMAL(18,3)` | yes | internal | min 0 | Emissions for the hour in kilograms of CO2 equivalent. |
| `emission_factor_version` | `STRING` | yes | internal |  | Version of the emission factor table used for the conversion. |
| `ingested_at` | `TIMESTAMP` | yes | internal |  | When the reading reached the gold table, in UTC. |

## Data quality

| Expectation | On violation | Predicate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `meter_id_not_null` | fail | `meter_id IS NOT NULL` |
| `meter_id_pattern` | drop | `meter_id RLIKE '^MTR-[0-9]{5}$'` |
| `reading_hour_not_null` | fail | `reading_hour IS NOT NULL` |
| `site_code_not_null` | drop | `site_code IS NOT NULL` |
| `site_code_pattern` | drop | `site_code RLIKE '^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{2}$'` |
| `asset_id_pattern` | drop | `asset_id IS NULL OR asset_id RLIKE '^AST-[0-9]{6}$'` |
| `energy_carrier_not_null` | fail | `energy_carrier IS NOT NULL` |
| `energy_carrier_allowed` | drop | `energy_carrier IN ('electricity', 'natural_gas', 'steam', 'compressed_air')` |
| `consumption_kwh_not_null` | drop | `consumption_kwh IS NOT NULL` |
| `consumption_kwh_min` | drop | `consumption_kwh >= 0` |
| `co2e_kg_not_null` | drop | `co2e_kg IS NOT NULL` |
| `co2e_kg_min` | drop | `co2e_kg >= 0` |
| `emission_factor_version_not_null` | drop | `emission_factor_version IS NOT NULL` |
| `ingested_at_not_null` | drop | `ingested_at IS NOT NULL` |
| `reading_not_in_future` | drop | `reading_hour <= current_timestamp()` |
| `emissions_need_consumption` | warn | `co2e_kg = 0 OR consumption_kwh > 0` |

## Semantic model measures

| Measure | Format | DAX |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Energy kWh | `#,0` | `SUM('energy_consumption'[consumption_kwh])` |
| Emissions kg CO2e | `#,0.0` | `SUM('energy_consumption'[co2e_kg])` |
| Electricity Share | `0.0%` | `DIVIDE(CALCULATE(SUM('energy_consumption'[consumption_kwh]), 'energy_consumption'[energy_carrier] = "electricity"), SUM('energy_consumption'[consumption_kwh]))` |
